data.exportHint: Recipes, pantry, shopping list and meal plan as a JSON file

data.importPaprikaHint: File ending in .paprikarecipes, up to 12 MB

data.tooLarge: The file is larger than 12 MB
data.backupHint: Creates a copy in the backups folder next to the database. The last 14 are kept.
data.calendarHint: With the subscription link your calendar shows the meal plan and keeps it up to date. Anyone with the link can see your plan. A new link disables the old one.
data.calendarActive: A subscription link is active. For security it is only shown right after it’s created.
data.calendarRemoveText: Calendars using the link will stop receiving updates.

api.title: API access
api.intro: With the REST API you control Pantry from your own scripts, shortcuts or Home Assistant. Every request needs a token.
api.step1: Sign in with username and password. The response header set-auth-token contains your token.
api.step2: Send the token with every request in the Authorization header.
api.step3: A new password signs out all tokens.
api.openapiHint: All endpoints with fields and responses
